turns.content: Provide a table listing all thermal power plants in Vietnam, including their fuel type (coal / local natural gas / imported LNG), construction stage, connection date (observed or planned COD), province, and generation capacity (in MWe). Format the response in CSV.

I cannot provide a complete, real-time list of all thermal power plants in Vietnam because such data is not publicly consolidated in a single authoritative source, and the sector is highly dynamic with frequent changes in construction status, COD dates, and capacity due to policy shifts (e.g., PDP8 revisions, coal phase-out commitments, and LNG transition). Additionally, many plants are privately owned or part of joint ventures with non-disclosed operational details.

However, I can provide a representative CSV dataset of major, publicly documented thermal power plants in Vietnam based on official EVN reports, Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) publications, and international energy databases (IEA, World Bank) as of 2023–2024. This includes only verified or widely reported projects. For complete or project-specific data, consult EVN's official power plant registry or MOIT's PDP8 implementation updates.
